newsitem.title: UK: Rank up as BZW repeats long-term buy stance.
newsitem.headline: Rank up as BZW repeats long-term buy stance.

text.p: Shares in Rank Group Plc firmed on Monday, defying the overall weaker market, as BZW, which acts as broker to Rank, reiterated its "long-term buy" recommendation.
By 0930 GMT Rank was up 5p at 390p.
"Friday's plunge was too much", Simon Johnson at BZW said, adding he still rated the hotel-to-leisure group as a "long-term buy".
On Friday, Rank shed 42p to end at 383-1/2p, after the company's seven percent growth in operating profits in the first five months disappointed the market.
"They are reasonably valued around this (current) level", said Paul Heath, analyst at UBS. Heath said he remained cautious on the stock which he cut to a "hold" from a "buy" last Monday.
